author: @fl0rianr

evidence.api_compatibility: This is a CI/infrastructure change only. No API, CLI, config, or user-facing surface is altered. No breaking changes.
evidence.documentation: docs/dev/testing.md was updated with a new 'Small docs-only PRs' subsection that documents eligibility rules, protected paths, retained jobs, and full-CI labels. The change was acknowledged by both author and reviewer.
evidence.manual_release_testing: The merge queue exercised every workflow with full CI. However, the docs-only fast path was never triggered in a real docs-only PR, and a matrix-name-expansion bug was identified that could cause the Build Embeddable Lemonade (Linux) check to hang on required-checks for docs-only PRs. The ci:label re-triggering was tested only in the cpp workflow; the other three workflows (docs_and_style, routing_schema_tests, server_download_registry) received labeled events in their on: triggers but the PR notes this was left as a known gap.
evidence.post_approval_commits: The CHANGES_REQUESTED review flagged that each gated job's if condition needed !cancelled() to avoid GitHub's implicit success() check, and that classify-small-docs-pr should be added to the aggregate needs lists. @sreeram-11 confirmed in a resolved inline comment that these changes were applied (each gated job uses !cancelled() && needs.full-ci-gate.result == 'success', and all three aggregates list classify-small-docs-pr + full-ci-gate in their needs). The post-approval commits stayed within the scope of the reviewer's guidance.
evidence.review: PR requested review from @jeremyfowers (CI area owner per docs/dev/contribute.md), but no formal review from them was found. @sreeram-11 submitted a CHANGES_REQUESTED review that identified three issues: (1) a blocker where the Build Embeddable Lemonade (Linux) matrix job could hang on a required check because GitHub does not expand matrix names when the job is skipped; (2) a minor that docs/dev/testing.md line 140 would be false for docs-only PRs; (3) that full-ci-gate should be added to the needs of the three aggregate gates (packaging-gate, backends-gate, macos-gate). The CHANGES_REQUESTED review was later superseded — @sreeram-11 resolved their own comment on the aggregate needs issue and submitted an APPROVED review. The code uses a fail-closed classifier that defaults to full CI on API errors, merge queue events, and non-PR events.
evidence.security: The new composite action uses actions/github-script@v8 with a GitHub token to list PR files. It reads no secrets, makes no network calls outside the GitHub API, and has no code execution. Supply-chain risk is limited to github-script@v8, which is the version already used elsewhere. No security concerns.
evidence.tests: CI passed on the merge queue for all four workflows (cpp_server_build_test_release, docs_and_style, routing_schema_tests, server_download_registry) plus validate_llamacpp and validate_sdcpp. No unit or integration tests accompany the new composite action or workflow changes. The PR author acknowledged: 'The docs-only fast path itself has not yet been exercised by a live docs-only PR.'

maintainer_todos.text: In a fork or personal branch with the same required checks, open a one-line docs-only PR and confirm that the Build Embeddable Lemonade (Linux) check completes instead of hanging at 'Expected — Waiting for status' on the raw matrix job name.

Open a docs-only PR and apply each of the ci:distros, ci:backends, ci:macos, and ci:upgrades labels one at a time, confirming that every affected workflow (cpp_server_build_test_release, docs_and_style, routing_schema_tests, server_download_registry) re-runs with full CI.

shout_outs.reason: Co-authored this PR and provided substantive review: identified a required-check hang risk on a matrix job and an aggregate needs-gap, both of which were resolved before merge.

subject: ci: skip expensive jobs for small docs-only PRs (#2889)
summary: Adds a classify-small-docs-pr composite action that gates four CI workflows behind a docs-only classifier, skipping expensive server, packaging, runtime and drift jobs for PRs touching only 1-5 Markdown files under docs/.
verdict_reason: The CI gating logic is fundamentally sound and the merge queue passed cleanly, but a known matrix-name-expansion edge case on the Linux embeddable build was reported by the reviewer but not resolved before merge.
